message:
PASS Manager lists open, closed, legacy and unlisted recovery projects
PASS Capacity display distinguishes estimated storage from guaranteed free space
PASS Closed-project search supports Korean project names
PASS Permanent deletion requires an explicit review confirmation
PASS Cancelling deletion preserves current and previous data
PASS Selected export embeds the selected image source despite identical internal CAD IDs
PASS Unused-image cleanup preserves the referenced current source
PASS Cleanup cannot remove another namespace with the same image identity
PASS A stale delete review preserves another window’s updated list and checkpoint
PASS Refreshing the project list preserves an unrelated live editing session
PASS Partial deletion failure restores the exact checkpoint, source and project entry
PASS Rollback leaves another live editor and its geometry intact
PASS Permanent deletion releases bytes without duplicate writes at the local-area limit
PASS Selected deletion preserves both another identical-ID project and legacy recovery
PASS Deleted project does not survive in the list backup
PASS An unlisted recovery copy can be registered without replacing its source
PASS Open editors require close-before-delete
PASS Other-project Undo/Redo survives storage cleanup and deletion
PASS Exported project reopens in a fresh namespace with self-contained image data
PASS Open-project export preserves the latest live snapshot even when local saving is full
PASS Manager close action saves the open source before releasing its editor
PASS Creating at the 200-project limit opens the storage manager without allocating another document
PASS A closed project at capacity still exports a portable file
PASS Explicit deletion frees the slot and selected local data at capacity
PASS A freed capacity slot can create a working independent project
PASS Interrupted delete restores the full original project list before editor load
PASS Interrupted delete restores its exact checkpoint and image source
PASS Recovery keeps the unrelated active project
PASS Recovery clears its journal only after exact list restoration
PASS A previously committed deletion is not resurrected by interruption recovery
